schemeShortTitle: Crop insurance scheme for all farmers.
schemeDescription: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) provides comprehensive insurance coverage for crop failure due to non-preventable natural risks, thereby stabilizing the income of farmers. It covers all Food and Oilseed crops for which past yield data is available.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibilityCriteria: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas are eligible. Farmers must have insurable interest in the crop.
benefits: Insurance coverage for loss of crops due to non-preventable natural calamities. Premium is subsidised by Central and State governments.
applicationProcess: Farmers can apply through Common Service Centres, bank branches, insurance companies, or the PMFBY portal at https://pmfby.gov.in/.

schemeShortTitle: Direct income support for small and marginal farmers.
schemeDescription: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme that provides income support of Rs.6000 per year in three equal instalments to all landholding farmer families across the country. The amount is directly transferred to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibilityCriteria: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land. Families with members who are Income Tax payees, retired pensioners, constitutional post holders, or professionals are excluded.
benefits: Rs.6000 per year in three equal instalments of Rs.2000 each, directly credited to bank account.
applicationProcess: Farmers can register through Common Service Centres, PM-KISAN portal, or State/District agriculture offices. Aadhaar seeding with bank account is mandatory.

schemeDescription: The Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme provides farmers with timely access to adequate and cost-effective credit for their agricultural operations. It covers short-term credit requirements for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing expenses, and allied activities.
eligibilityCriteria: All farmers — individual or joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and self-help groups of farmers — are eligible.
benefits: Flexible credit up to Rs.3 lakh at concessional interest rate of 4% per annum (with prompt repayment rebate). Credit for crop production, maintenance, and allied activities.
applicationProcess: Apply through any scheduled commercial bank, cooperative bank, or regional rural bank (RRB). Required documents to be submitted at nearest bank branch.
